evidence: Has the P2P area label and modifies Tor control and listener setup in src/torcontrol.cpp and src/torcontrol.h.
rationale: Prevents incoming Tor peers from being misclassified and inheriting local whitelist permissions when explicit binds lack a dedicated onion listener. As noted in the description, incoming Tor connections could previously be routed to standard listeners where they "may be misclassified and inherit IP-based whitelist permissions (such as -whitelist=127.0.0.1)".
